access_notes: Pattern E2 - blocked on every simple route, reachable via one specific Playwright recipe. www.sussexpartnership.nhs.uk sits behind Imperva/Incapsula (CNAME 8gdsmqk.ng.impervadns.net, X-CDN: Imperva), which drops or 503s HTML for plain curl, browser-UA curl, HTTP/1.1- and TLS1.2-forced curl, port 80, server-side WebFetch (socket hang up), the Jina reader and public CORS proxies alike. Archive.org Save Page Now now requires a login so that fallback is closed, and Wayback's last good HTML capture of this page is 2026-02-02 (403 from 2026-02-21 on). WHAT WORKS (confirmed 2026-09-26): local headless Playwright Chromium with a real Chrome UA, locale en-GB, and HTTP/2 LEFT ENABLED (--disable-http2 makes it worse: ERR_EMPTY_RESPONSE). GET /robots.txt first - it is whitelisted, returns 200 even to bare curl, and sets visid_incap_3332221 + incap_ses_576_3332221 - then wait at least 20s, because robots.txt declares crawl-delay: 20 and Imperva enforces it; then navigate to the board page retrying up to 4x with ~24s gaps (attempt 0 is typically 503, attempt 1 ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR, and a later attempt returns 200 once Chromium has executed /_Incapsula_Resource?SWJIYLWA=...). Reuse that same browser context for the PDF GETs with Referer set to the board page and >=20s between requests. Single-attempt crawls always fail. The DB URL IS the archive: one level, no year drilldown and no per-meeting sub-pages, and no separate document-library subdomain. Content is server-rendered despite a closed accordion (button aria-expanded=false, id=single-accordion-34271; optional deep link ?open=34271), so no JS is needed to extract links once past the WAF - financial-year h2 headings (2026/27 back to 2023/24) each wrap a ul of one-per-item links in two interchangeable forms: direct /application/files/{4d}/{4d}/{4d}/{Name}.pdf, and indirect /download_file/view/{id}/292 which 303s to an /application/files path (292 is the board-papers file set; ids increment chronologically). Each meeting carries a 'Papers' entry - the combined pack, prefer this - plus a 'Minutes' entry added about two months later; do not mistake Minutes for the pack. Filenames are wildly inconsistent (Published_Board_Pack.pdf, Board_Pack.pdf, 00_-_BoD_Agenda_June_2026_PUBLIC-combined_5.pdf, 2025.08.07_-_Public_Board_of_Directors_-_Combined_Pack_V2.pdf, Board_of_Directors_-_October_2025.pdf), so NEVER construct a URL from a date - scrape the anchor text, which is the only reliable date source. Before a meeting the entry may be agenda-only (the 8 Oct 2026 link is currently a 2-page DRAFT agenda, swapped for the ~450-page pack around the meeting date), so re-check file size / page count rather than just link presence. Scheduled dates slip - trust the Meeting Papers list over the 'Future Meetings' block (Feb 2026 advertised 11 June 2026; the meeting actually ran 18 June). Packs are 350-460pp and 10-16MB, so allow >240s timeouts. Bi-monthly single-trust Board of Directors, not a cluster board; next public boards 8 October 2026, 10 December 2026, 11 February 2027. Council of Governors papers are a separate sibling page at /about-us/how-our-trust-run/council-governors/council-governors-meetings. Recordings at youtube.com/@SussexPartnershipNHS/videos; governance contact spft.corporategovernance@nhs.net.
